model_annotation: The two line graphs display the relationship between the variable BLEU and two different parameters, α and ρ, respectively. Both graphs share a common y-axis labeled "BLEU" with a linear scale ranging from 28.0 to 28.5, marked in increments of 0.1. The left graph plots BLEU against α, where the x-axis ranges from 0.1 to 0.9 with a linear scale and is marked at intervals of 0.2. The data is represented by a single blue line with circular markers. The line starts at a BLEU value of approximately 28.01 at α = 0.1, rises to a peak of approximately 28.52 at α = 0.5, and then decreases to approximately 28.18 at α = 0.9. The right graph plots BLEU against ρ, with the x-axis ranging from 0.05 to 0.45 on a linear scale, marked at intervals of 0.05. The data is also represented by a single blue line with circular markers. The line begins at a BLEU value of approximately 28.31 at ρ = 0.05, increases to a peak of approximately 28.52 at ρ = 0.15, then decreases to approximately 28.40 at ρ = 0.25, rises again to approximately 28.45 at ρ = 0.35, and finally decreases to approximately 28.41 at ρ = 0.45.
